intake.title: Pre-interview form
intake.consent: I give my explicit consent for the health information I share in this form to be processed by my dietitian for the purpose of nutrition counselling.
intake.consentRequired: Please tick the consent box to continue
intake.bloodTestNote: Please send your blood test results from the last 3 months via WhatsApp. If you have not had one, please get a blood test covering: complete blood count, fasting blood glucose, insulin, HbA1c, thyroid tests (TSH, T3, T4), iron, B12, vitamin D, cholesterol and triglyceride profile, liver and kidney function tests.
intake.doctorNote: If you have a chronic disease or take medication regularly, ask your doctor whether there is any specific nutrition advice for you.
intake.thanks: Your form has been sent to your dietitian. If anything changes, you can update it any time from the Profile page.
